preconditions.description: The input verb must be a string.
The input verb must end with 'ar', 'er', or 'ir'.

postconditions.description: The return value must be a dictionary.
The dictionary must contain exactly one key-value pair.
The dictionary key must be the original verb.
The dictionary value must be a list.
The list must contain exactly six elements.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(word, str) for word in list(return_value.values())[0])
postconditions.description: All elements in the list must be strings.
